home.label: Home
home.description: Provide a stable desktop frame for every tool.

library.label: Library
library.description: Manage the personal library, import novels from ZIP packages and export a novel's source data back as a package.

reader.label: Content
reader.description: Browse, read, search and edit source content by chapter.

storyworld.label: Omniscient
storyworld.description: Build and maintain a shared source of truth for entities and terms.

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Translate in batches, keep names consistent, edit and check for errors.

storychat.label: Story chat
storychat.description: Grounded Q&A within the chapter range the user allows.

voicelab.label: Voice Lab
voicelab.description: Create, clone, save and assign consistent voices to the narrator and characters.

pronunciation.label: Pronunciation
pronunciation.description: Standardize how proper names, terms and loanwords are read in TTS.

assets.label: Media Assets
assets.description: Manage consistent images and voices per story entity.

sound.label: Sound and Music
sound.description: Create and manage BGM, themes, ambience and SFX for adapted content.

audiobook.label: Audiobook
audiobook.description: Turn translated chapters into audio with consistent character voices.

film.label: Film Series
film.description: Turn a novel into scripts and short episodes.

videoeditor.label: Video editor
videoeditor.description: Combine images, clips, dialogue, music and subtitles, and manage renders.

inbox.label: Media inbox
inbox.description: Receive and manage external media the user designates.

publishing.label: Publishing
publishing.description: Package and distribute finished works per target channel.

tasks.label: Task Center
tasks.description: Run, track and resume long AI tasks without blocking the UI.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Manage app settings and choose the CLI for each task type.
